thesis: The "Vault Manager Basket" continues to focus on tracking and managing futures related to the S&P 500 index, specifically the E-Mini and Micro E-Mini S&P 500 futures. This strategy aims to provide diversified exposure to the US equity market, leveraging the liquidity and volatility of these futures to optimize returns. The current market conditions show a slight upward momentum, which aligns with our long-only strategy.
